results.title: [Hiring] Software Engineer for VA Work | $30/hr | Remote
results.description:
I'm looking for someone with a software engineering background who wants to make some extra money doing VA work.

The pay is $30/hr and it's fully remote.

Basically, I need someone to help me with my LinkedIn, emails, and scheduling calls. Nothing too complicated, mostly checking messages, managing connection requests, engaging with people on LinkedIn, and arranging meetings.

notice: Date publice, fără verificarea identității sau a bugetului. Nu reprezintă contracte confirmate. Nu s-au trimis oferte sau mesaje. Lista zilnică este publică pe GitHub.
